title.es: El de cuando Fina no irá a la boda
title.en: The One Where Fina Won't Go to the Wedding

description.es: Marta le dice a Andrés que sigue adelante con el matrimonio para proteger a Fina y que quiere a Fina más que a nada. Andrés le dice a Fina que Marta no quiere que vaya a la boda, porque sabe que Fina sufriría muchísimo si fuera. Fina dice que no irá a la boda. Carmen y Claudia intentan animar a Fina. Carmen le dice a Fina que, aunque no vaya a la boda, debería ir a ver a Marta antes.
description.en: Marta tells Andrés that she is going through with the marriage to protect Fina and that she loves Fina more than anything. Andrés tells Fina that Marta does not want her to come to the wedding, because she knows Fina would suffer greatly if she went. Fina says that she will not go to the wedding. Carmen and Claudia try to cheer Fina up. Carmen tells Fina that even if she does not go to the wedding, she should go to see Marta before it.
